##: The installer is a PE with the payload stored as a ZIP resource; 7-Zip opens it directly, so the URL carries a #/dl.7z fragment to make Scoop unpack instead of execute it.

Unpacking yields install\{YYAnchor.exe, Launcher.xml, <version>\}; the vendor layout is kept on purpose because the 289 KiB YYAnchor.exe is a launcher that loads the versioned mainframe.dll named by Launcher.xml.
The manifest version follows the CDN directory (X.Y.Z.0), not the build number in the PE (3.19.0.5576), so the autoupdate URL substitution stays valid.

No checkver: the vendor gates every version source behind request signing. v.yy.com resolves the installer through lpfm2-download.yy.com/installer/getInstaller, which answers 204 'no installer' outside the mainland service, and up.yy.com/api/check/yyanchor/check4update needs an MD5 nonce and returns 'no rule found' for every sourceVersion tried. Bump version and hash by hand.
description: YY Anchor (YY开播) live-streaming studio with virtual camera output for Windows
notes: Only the x64 build is published.
The installer build is 3.19.0.5576, as shown in the app; the manifest version tracks the CDN directory 3.19.0.0 so the download and autoupdate URLs stay valid.
The unpacked layout is the vendor one: YYAnchor.exe (launcher), Launcher.xml and the versioned payload directory. Do not flatten it.
The bundled update.exe updates the app in place, which adds a new version directory under the Scoop app folder. Reinstalling with 'scoop install yy-anchor -f' returns to the packaged build.

The DirectShow filters for the virtual camera (YYVirtualCam*.ax, YYVCamService.exe) only work once registered; that registration is done by the vendor installer, not by Scoop, so camera output in OBS/Zoom may need a manual registration step.
User data, logs and cache live in the YYAnchor folders under %APPDATA% and %LOCALAPPDATA%, so nothing is persisted by Scoop.
